title: LC-MS/MS analysis of steroids in plasma
author: Catriona Kyle
materials: Prepare 100 µg/mL solutions of each isotopically labelled internal standard (d4-cortisol, 13 C 3 -testosterone, 13 C 3 -androstenedione and d9-progesterone) in methanol.

Set up an acquisition batch in Analyst software using the electronic excel file of the calibration standards and sample list. Set to inject 10 µL per sample and use a method of chromatographic separation as described in step 16 and 17 and mass spectrometer settings as outlined in steps 18 and 19.

Use MultiQuant software and Microsoft Excel to evaluate the LC-MS/MS data, by defining calibration standard levels, ensuring accuracy of the calibration standards and linear regression > 0.99. steps.title: Prepare individual steroid stock solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve d8‑corticosterone powder to make a 1 mg/mL stock, then prepare 100 µg/mL stocks of d8‑corticosterone, cortisol (F), 17α‑hydroxyprogesterone (17OHP4), testosterone (T) and androstenedione (A4) in methanol.

steps.title: Prepare mixed steroid stock (5 µg/mL)
steps.instruction: Combine the five 100 µg/mL steroid stocks by adding 50 µL of each (d8‑B, F, 17OHP4, T, A4) and 750 µL methanol; vortex to obtain a mixed stock at 5 µg/mL.

steps.title: Create serial dilutions of mixed stock
steps.instruction: Perform successive 1:10 dilutions of the mixed stock using methanol to generate the following concentrations:

substeps.instruction: Dilute 5 µg/mL stock: mix 100 µL of 5 µg/mL stock with 900 µL methanol → 500 ng/mL stock.
Dilute 500 ng/mL stock: mix 100 µL of 500 ng/mL stock with 900 µL methanol → 50 ng/mL stock.
Dilute 50 ng/mL stock: mix 100 µL of 50 ng/mL stock with 900 µL methanol → 5 ng/mL stock.
Dilute 5 ng/mL stock: mix 100 µL of 5 ng/mL stock with 900 µL methanol → 500 pg/mL stock.
Dilute 500 pg/mL stock: mix 100 µL of 500 pg/mL stock with 900 µL methanol → 50 pg/mL stock (then return to step 2 if further dilutions are required).

steps.title: Prepare internal standard mix (5 µg/mL)
steps.instruction: Make a 5 µg/mL internal‑standard mix by adding 25 µL each of 100 µg/mL d4‑cortisol, 13C₃‑testosterone, 13C₃‑androstenedione and d9‑progesterone to 425 µL methanol; vortex to mix.

steps.title: Prepare working internal standard (5 ng/mL)
steps.instruction: Dilute the internal‑standard mix to 5 ng/mL by adding 10 µL of the 5 µg/mL mix to 1990 µL methanol; vortex.

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards in 96-well plate
steps.instruction: Using Table S2, pipette the appropriate volumes of each stock concentration into a 96‑well deep‑well plate so that each well contains a final volume of 200 µL water.

steps.title: Label plates and design batch layout
steps.instruction: Label a 2 mL deep‑well 96‑well collection plate (Biotage), a Supported Liquid Extraction SLE400 plate, and a 2 mL deep‑well 96‑well collection plate (Waters) with batch details; create a column‑wise plate map in the provided Excel template (Table S1).

steps.title: Add internal standard to calibration wells
steps.instruction: Using a multi‑step pipette, add 20 µL of the 5 ng/mL working internal standard to each calibration standard well, to each plasma sample well, and to the zero‑standard well; omit the double blank and solvent blank.

steps.title: Program Extrahera to add formic acid
steps.instruction: Load the Extrahera robot with the labelled SLE400 extraction plate and the deep‑well plate containing standards and samples; program it to dispense 200 µL of 0.1 % formic acid in water into each well of the deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Transfer samples to SLE extraction plate
steps.instruction: Program the Extrahera to transfer 400 µL from each deep‑well (sample plus diluent) onto a 400 µL capacity SLE400 plate positioned on the deck, with a Waters 2 mL deep‑well collection plate beneath to receive eluates; ensure the collection plate is pre‑labelled with batch details and extraction date.

steps.title: Adsorb and elute samples from SLE
steps.instruction: Allow the transferred sample to adsorb onto the SLE bed for 00:05:00, then elute three times with 600 µL of a 98:2 (v/v) dichloromethane/isopropanol mixture, collecting each eluate into the collection plate.

steps.title: Dry eluates under nitrogen
steps.instruction: Place the collection plate in a SPE Dry‑down system for 96‑well plates and evaporate the eluates to dryness under a gentle stream of nitrogen.

steps.title: Resuspend extracts and shake
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of a 70:30 water/methanol solution to each well, seal the plate with a zone‑free seal, and shake on a ThermoShaker for 00:05:00 at 300 rpm, °C.

steps.title: Store plate or load into autosampler
steps.instruction: Either place the sealed plate directly into the LC‑MS/MS autosampler or store it at –20 °C until analysis is ready.

steps.title: Set up LC system and column
steps.instruction: Configure the Shimadzu Nexera X2 LC system with a Phenomenex Krud Katcher and a 150 × 3 mm, 2.6 µm Kinetex C18 column; set mobile phase A to water + 0.1 % formic acid, mobile phase B to methanol + 0.1 % formic acid, flow rate to 0.5 mL/min, column temperature to 40 °C, and divert flow to the mass spectrometer at 0.2 min.

steps.title: Configure chromatographic gradient
steps.instruction: Program the gradient as described in Table S3 with a total run time of 00:16:00 per injection.

steps.title: Configure mass spectrometer MRM method
steps.instruction: Set the mass spectrometer to Multiple Reaction Monitoring (MRM) in positive electrospray mode as detailed in Table S4; divert LC flow to the MS from 1 min to 12 min.

steps.title: Load MRM transitions for steroids
steps.instruction: Enter the MRM transitions for each analyte and its isotopically labelled internal standard as listed in Table S5.

steps.title: Verify steroid retention times
steps.instruction: Run a test injection and confirm that retention times match the expected values: cortisol 4.0 min, d8‑corticosterone 6.1 min, androstenedione 7.3 min, testosterone 7.8 min, 17α‑hydroxyprogesterone 8.1 min (see Fig S1).

steps.title: Inject mid‑level standard and run batch
steps.instruction: Inject a mid‑level calibration standard; verify chromatography, retention times and peak‑area responses; once acceptable, start the batch run injecting 10 µL per sample.

steps.title: Thaw plasma samples on ice
steps.instruction: Remove human plasma samples from the freezer and allow them to defrost on ice.

steps.title: Aliquot plasma into designated wells
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL of each thawed plasma sample into the appropriate well of the deep‑well plate according to the plate‑map design.

steps.title: Analyze data using provided parameters
steps.instruction: Apply the data‑analysis parameters from Table S6 to quantify peak areas of each steroid and its corresponding internal standard.
